IV imposes (100,000 cfs over the Falls in tourist-season daytime vs 50,000 otherwise). St Lawrence (EIA 2694) -> 168 h: stated IN WORDS by the IJC 2016-12-08 Supplementary Order under Regulation Plan 2014 ('the approved WEEKLY flow regulation plan') plus the peaking-and-ponding directive, a published categorical duration class.
